status: preregistered before execution; candidate, not reviewed or accepted

system.family: verbatim personal memory: drawers in a local vector store, hybrid vector + BM25 rerank
system.product: MemPalace 3.11.0 @ 602d796c699cabba2971982cd9dccbbf46abfe79 (MIT), installed tree hash-checked in its own interpreter
system.embedder: chroma ONNX all-MiniLM-L6-v2, files pinned in ../model-pins.txt; 1 embedding thread; offline
system.capability_tier: no LLM at ingestion or retrieval (same tier as agent-memory and bm25)

adapter.search: mempalace_search(query, limit=k), k = AMB per-case retrieval_limit (maxBeliefs, default 20); mapped list cut to k
adapter.isolation: one palace and MCP server per AMB user_id

protocol.command: python scripts/run_amb_local_evidence.py --amb-root /tmp/agent-memory-benchmark --python /tmp/am-bench/graphiti-amb-venv/bin/python --evidence-dir <dir> --set-env TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/am-bench/tiktoken-cache --set-env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 --set-env PYTHONHASHSEED=0 --set-env MEMPALACE_PYTHON=/tmp/am-bench/mempalace-venv/bin/python --set-env MEMPALACE_BENCH_MODEL_DIR=<pinned MiniLM dir> -- run --dataset precisionmembench --split single-turn --memory mempalace-local --mode retrieval

runs.repeat: rep 2, a full fresh rerun, as repeatability evidence; never substituted

outcomes: AMB native correct/77, pass classes, mean precision/recall, per-category passes
per-case paired comparison with agent-memory rep 1 and bm25 (scripts/compare_amb_runs.py) with exact McNemar
failure_rules: a provider or harness exception fails the run; reported, not scored
comparability: Same harness, inputs, budgets, scorer, protocol A and capability tier (no LLM) as agent-memory 15/77 and bm25 8/77.
smoke: synthetic-smoke.json: 4 hand-written documents, all 5 structural checks passed before this registration
